summary_points: This document is an engineering specification for the supply of instruments for the Solana project.
The specification includes definitions for terms like Supplier, Customer, Fabricator, and Owner.
The scope of work involves supplying all instruments listed in the request for quote, including cables, gaskets, manifolds, etc.
Supplier is responsible for delivering material to selected Fabricators or the jobsite.
The contract allows for alternate billing cycles upon request from the owner.
Quality requirements for material compliance with standards
Vendor commitment to supply data and complete 'Vendor Commitment' column
Quotation must include time for approval drawings and fabrication
Equipment delivery by August 2012
Spare parts list required with prices and delivery times
Inspection by Abener Teyma personnel before shipment
Alternate quotations invited with details
Specifications prepared using accepted engineering practices
Shipment requirements for equipment protection
The equipment is a Guided Wave Radar Through Cable with a magnetic coupled float output signal.
It measures HTF level in a still well tank.
The transmitter model is MT5000/S6/LW/A/C1V/P11/CW09D-S6/H6/M7A/FM/FL-CST-R153/2626mm.
Accuracy is ± 0.1% of calibrated range with a digital LCD display.
The equipment requires a 2" pipe mounting kit and has NEMA 4X enclosure protection.
Stilling well and isolation valves are to be provided by the owner.
